name: Two-part blocks: doors, beds, tall plants
deviations: tall grass, large ferns and other tall plants are not modeled
note: Doors: the halves follow each other, a half without the other breaks (the lower one with the drop), and placed doors take their hinges as both official servers do; sunflowers, lilacs, rose bushes and peonies: placed with both halves, the lower one on soil, and both gone when either half or the soil goes (the lower one with the drop); beds: placed with both halves, the foot facing the player's way, a half leaving with the other, only the head dropping the bed
